text:
alex: Weekend brain-teaser  espresso crawl at Little Oak (10am) vs ridge hike + picnic (8:30am). caffeine or cardio? :coffee: :mountain:

mira: Espresso crawl for me. need small-batch crema therapy. :coffee:

jon: Hike. trying to make my legs remember what hills are. plus picnic sounds nice. :backpack:

tess: Both? hike early, grab espresso after? could be a tactical win. :thinking_face:

alex: Love that. meetup plan idea: hike 8:30am trailhead, finish ~10:30, then espresso at Little Oak by 11. who9s in?

mira: I can do that if someone saves me a seat at the cafe. priority: cortado. :drooling_face:

jon: I9m in for both. bringing blanket + savory muffins. also a pack of sunscreen.

tess: Bringing a frisbee in case we need low-effort entertainment. also a small folding chair.

bot-ryan: Event tentative: "Ridge Hike + Espresso Crawl" Sat 8:30 AM (Trailhead) -> 11:00 AM (Little Oak)  RSVP: https://calendar.company/events/58012

mira: RSVP'd for espresso. will try to make the hike but might be late (morning yoga).

alex: Quick logistical note: trailhead parking is limited. carpools encouraged. anyone driving from Mission?

jon: I have 2 seats. leaving lobby 7:45. will bring folding tarp in case ground is damp.

tess: GIF: https://giphy.com/frisbee-fun.gif :grin:

mira: Also FYI Little Oak takes cashless only. i9ll cover a round if someone spots me for muffins.

alex: Gentle reminder: no glass on the trail and pack out trash. leave it better than we found it. :seedling:

jon: Good call. i9ll bring resealable bags for waste + compostables.

tess: Vote tally: hike+espresso hybrid wins. looks like a wholesome saturday. see y9all! :sun_with_face:
